svg.aria-label: Shafa — A prescription, written the way it is on paper. Prescriptions and patient records for a clinic doctor: 24 letterhead designs, a QR and 8-letter code against forged prescriptions, allergy and duplicate-ingredient warnings. Patient data stays on the device.
